answer: Each identity pays a 45-credit join fee into the shale registry, burned on entry, and locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch a zephyr beacon picks identities by lot; each must send a fresh key-signed signal, and a missing or copied signal burns its bond. Join fees start 45, rise 5: a thousand fakes owe 2,542,500 vs a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 45 once, keeping its bond. A shared-bond ring fails: each signal is key-bound.
